service.name: openagents-decision-gateway
service.base_url_note: No public endpoint is published in this repository. The base URL is operator configuration: --url, OPENAGENTS_BASE_URL, or the config file's base_url.
service.description: The keyed HTTP front of the decision service. Every decision call runs one admission path: authenticate, authorize the named door, bound declared capacity, reserve quota durably, verify the backend's published identity, forward, settle, and receipt.

sources: api_key field of a mode-0600 config file
authentication.provisioning: Operator-issued through the tenant-keys binary against the registry; there is no signup, self-serve issuance, or key-creation endpoint.
authentication.anonymous: A call with no Authorization header reaches only the manifest's shared doors; when the deployment sets require_workspace_membership it is refused 401 unauthenticated.
authentication.workspace_header: X-Workspace-Id: required exactly once per call when the deployment sets require_workspace_membership; mandatory under monetary admission.

request_conventions.idempotency: Idempotency-Key plus X-Attempt identify a (request, attempt) pair the quota ledger settles under. A retry keeps the key and bumps the attempt; a settled pair, or the pair reused against changed content, answers 409 idempotency_conflict. Without a key the gateway mints a request id.
request_conventions.batch: Two shapes exist: the oak CLI's --input lines|ndjson client-side loop issues one POST /v1/systemone per input row; POST /v1/jobs submits a durable classification batch the gateway persists and the caller collects through GET /v1/jobs/{id}/results.
request_conventions.content_type: application/json; the gateway parses the body as JSON regardless of the declared type.
request_conventions.body_limit: max_body_bytes is operator configuration (default 1048576); an oversized body is refused 413.

error.code: a stable snake_case string; the gateway-owned set is enumerated under refusal_codes, and a backend may pass through its own codes
error.request: the request identity, present on refusals raised inside the owned admission path
error.attempt: the attempt number, present on refusals raised inside the owned admission path

refusal_shape.settlement: optional on gateway refusals under monetary admission: the hold's resolution — settled, outstanding, or released

post_route_headers.x-request-id: the request identity — the Idempotency-Key when sent, else minted
post_route_headers.x-attempt: the attempt that produced this response
post_route_headers.x-outcome: answered | refused | unavailable | unattempted, plus mixed on POST /v1/classify
post_route_headers.x-receipt: the digest of the sealed ExecutionReceipt appended to receipts.jsonl
post_route_headers.x-settlement: the monetary hold's resolution — settled | outstanding | released — only under monetary admission
post_route_headers.retry-after: seconds to wait before retrying; present on 429 responses
post_route_headers.scope: These headers are emitted on POST /v1/systemone and POST /v1/classify only. The GET routes do not carry them.

routes.summary: Answer typed questions about one state.

shape.model: string — the door name, resolved against the caller's bindings
shape.state: any JSON value or string — the document every question reads
shape.questions: object of question-id to question; ids are caller-side and never reach the model

question.instructions: the judgment to make — a string or structured object
question.criteria: noul: optional {true:…, false:…}; choice: object of option to description; score: array of 2–10 ordered level descriptions

bounds.max_questions: configurable, default 256 — over it answers 422 too_many_questions
bounds.max_options: configurable, default 4096 — over it answers 422 too_many_options

shape.answers: one typed answer per question id: {type:'noul',noul,selected?} | {type:'choice',choice,confidence,probabilities} | {type:'score',score,confidence,selected?,legend,probabilities}
shape.usage: {input_tokens?, output_tokens?} — either absent when the backend does not count it

200.note: The backend's answer arrives verbatim with the backend's status; a backend may add fields or its own typed refusal codes.

413: body over max_body_bytes — the platform refusal may not carry the typed error shape
503: price_invalid — last two monetary admission only

notes: Independent questions over one state belong in one request; questions cannot read each other's answers.
The gateway verifies the backend's published model card against the binding before forwarding; a disagreement is identity_mismatch and never bills the caller.
oak's --input lines|ndjson issues one of these calls per row; there is no bulk request shape.

routes.summary: Classify ordered inputs under an explicit selection policy — a facade over per-input systemone calls.

notes: capacity names the binding's lane — shared, dedicated, trained, or on-device; anything else is 422 unsupported_capacity.
The door must declare classify limits in the gateway configuration; undeclared support is 422 unsupported_limits, never an inferred product maximum.
Review and fallback are opt-in sub-documents of the policy (openagents.classify-review.v1), not separate routes.

200.shape: openagents.classify.v1 report: v, model, capacity, policy, served, outcome (answered|mixed), outcomes{answered,refused,unavailable,unattempted}, results[] in input order, selections[], aggregates[], usage{forwards,input_tokens_complete,output_tokens_complete,input_tokens?,output_tokens?,review?,fallback?}, timing{latency_ms}, review?

responses.422: Either a typed refusal (envelope rejected before dispatch) or a report whose dispatched units were all refused.
responses.503: Either a typed refusal or a report carrying unavailable or unattempted work — a completed report is still a report; inspect it rather than retrying it as unattempted.

400: invalid_request — the envelope did not parse
503: price_invalid — last two monetary admission only

notes: One native request is forwarded per input under a bounded scheduler; results reassemble in input order.
Discovery of each door's declared bounds is the classification object on its GET /v1/models card.
Partial outcomes are preserved: refused, unavailable, and unattempted items are named, never dropped.

routes.summary: List the doors the caller's credential may name, with the identity each is bound to.

headers: Authorization (optional — anonymous sees shared doors only)

models.id: the door name a request uses in model
models.model: the artifact id the binding expects the backend to publish
models.artifact_signature: the content digest the binding pins, when it pins one

admission.scope: the question families an admission record covered — trained lane only
admission.record: the admission record's digest — trained lane only
admission.registry_digest: the manifest revision that authorized this card

models.classification: the openagents.classify-discovery.v1 card: status configured | unsupported | unavailable | invalid-limits, plus declared limits, modes, admission ceilings, and execution shape when configured

200.note: This is the registry's claim — which doors exist for this caller and what they are pinned to — not a statement about backend health, and never remote attestation. A listed door can still refuse at identity check.
Liveness for a load balancer. It is not readiness and reveals nothing about doors or backends; identity verification runs per request.

routes.condition: Routed only when the deployment configures monetary admission (a money document in gateway.json, which itself requires require_workspace_membership). Under a configuration without money the route does not exist at all.
routes.summary: Read the caller's workspace account position and the configured doors' price versions.

headers: X-Workspace-Id (required — the account the read is scoped to)

shape.workspace: the workspace the read is scoped to
shape.balance: {currency, credited, reserved, settled, refunded, available, spend_remaining}
shape.prices: object of door name to {version, policy, currency} — the price versions the configured doors charge under

404: account_missing — the workspace holds no monetary account
unmetered — defensive; unreachable in practice because the route is registered only when monetary admission is configured

notes: There is no top-up, payment, or credit mutation over HTTP — POST, PUT, and DELETE on this route are refused; funding is an operator act on the ledger.

routes.summary: Submit a durable classification job — the openagents.classify.v1 envelope plus optional notify and export policy, persisted before any forward runs.

shape.classify: an openagents.classify.v1 envelope — the same request POST /v1/classify takes
shape.notify: optional {url, events} — a webhook the gateway signs and posts on terminal state
shape.idempotency: an explicit Idempotency-Key dedupes; a keyless submission mints a random one and cannot dedupe a retry

request.bounds: the classify envelope's own bounds plus a caller-visible job cap; over it answers the typed refusal

shape.job: the status document: id, state queued, submitted timing, manifest and status digests

responses.409: idempotency_conflict — the same key against different content

422: the classify envelope's validation refusals, plus invalid_notify and notify_not_configured

notes: docs/decision-models/service/durable-jobs.md is the contract: manifest first, index after; recovery replays nonterminal jobs on restart.

routes.summary: Read a job's status document — state, counts, timing, digests, and the terminal receipt when finished.

headers: Authorization — the submitting credential's jobs only

shape.job: state queued|running|cancelling|succeeded|failed|cancelled, counts{total,done,failed}, submitted/started/finished timing, manifest_sha256, status_sha256, receipt?

responses.404: unknown or another caller's job id

routes.summary: Delete a terminal job's record before the retention sweep would.

responses.409: job_running — a live job cannot be deleted

routes.summary: Cancel a live job — a durable marker the runner checks; the status read reports cancelling until the runner settles.

shape.job: the status document with state cancelling

routes.summary: Export a finished job's items — bounded pages under a cursor that expires after job_cursor_ttl_ms (default one hour).

query: cursor — opaque, from the previous page

shape.items: the finished per-input results in submission order
shape.job: identity and digests the page belongs to

responses.410: cursor_expired — an expired cursor answers, never silently restarts

409: job_running — results exist only once terminal

routes.summary: Rotate a job's webhook signing secret — the old secret stops verifying deliveries immediately.

shape.notify: the new secret — shown once, never logged

responses.404: unknown job or no notify configured

routes.summary: List the bundled documentation corpus — the openagents.docs.v1 envelope with document metadata, total, and next_cursor.

query: cursor — opaque paging token bound to corpus and operation

shape.corpus_sha256: the corpus version every cursor binds
shape.documents: metadata rows: id, title, source, source_path, sha256, bytes, example

routes.summary: Search the corpus — at most one bounded snippet per matching document.

200.shape: the list_docs envelope plus line, snippet, and snippet_truncated on each row

responses.400: invalid_arguments when q is absent, empty, or over-bound

routes.summary: List the corpus's runnable examples — envelopes and question sets to fetch through /v1/docs/{id}.

200.shape: the list_docs envelope restricted to example documents

routes.summary: Read a bounded UTF-8 page of one document by stable id — document ids never resolve to filesystem paths or URLs.

query: cursor — page offset within the document

malformed.meaning: the Authorization header is not text

invalid_request.meaning: the body is not a JSON envelope, the envelope names no model door, or a classify envelope failed schema or plan validation

workspace_required.meaning: membership mode requires exactly one X-Workspace-Id header

unauthenticated.meaning: no Bearer shape, or an unknown, revoked, or wrong credential

insufficient_funds.meaning: monetary admission: no provisioned account, or the hold exceeds the available balance or remaining authorized spend

door_not_bound.meaning: the tenant holds no binding for the named door and the door is not shared

workspace_forbidden.meaning: the credential has no active membership in the named workspace and tenant

account_missing.meaning: the workspace holds no monetary account

unmetered.meaning: the gateway does not run monetary admission — defensive; the balance route is not registered in that configuration

idempotency_conflict.meaning: the (request, attempt) pair is taken — already resolved, or held for different content

too_many_questions.meaning: the request carries more questions than the gateway admits (default bound 256)

too_many_options.meaning: the request totals more options than the gateway admits (default bound 4096)

unsupported_schema.meaning: the classify envelope's v is not openagents.classify.v1

unsupported_mode.meaning: the classify envelope plans a mode the door does not serve

unsupported_limits.meaning: the door declares no classify bounds, or bounds the facade cannot serve

unsupported_capacity.meaning: the request names a capacity lane other than the binding's

invalid_id.meaning: a classify input, label, or dimension id is empty, over-long, or otherwise invalid

too_many_inputs.meaning: the classify envelope carries more inputs than the door's declared bound

too_many_labels.meaning: the classify envelope carries more labels than the door's declared bound

too_many_levels.meaning: a score unit's rubric exceeds the door's declared levels bound

too_many_dimensions.meaning: the classify envelope carries more dimensions than the door's declared bound

too_many_judgments.meaning: the classify envelope plans more total judgments than the door's declared bound

content_too_large.meaning: a classify field exceeds the door's declared byte bound

overflow.meaning: the classify plan's judgment arithmetic overflowed

context_limit.meaning: an expanded classify request exceeds the door's declared max_forward_bytes; the gateway never truncates

rate_limited.meaning: the door's declared calls-per-minute window is full

busy.meaning: the door's declared forward slots are full

overloaded.meaning: the gateway's process-wide forward bound is full

quota_exhausted.meaning: the tenant's daily budget is spent — retrying cannot fix a spent allowance

registry_unavailable.meaning: the registry could not be read

ledger_unavailable.meaning: the quota or monetary ledger refused or failed a write

membership_unavailable.meaning: the workspace membership store is unavailable

door_unavailable.meaning: the door is bound but no backend is configured, or its identity could not be read

identity_mismatch.meaning: the backend's published card disagrees with the binding — the caller is never billed for it

unavailable.meaning: the forward failed — transport, a 5xx, a redirect, or an oversized response

unpriced.meaning: monetary admission: the door has no configured price

price_invalid.meaning: monetary admission: the configured price disagrees with the binding

backend_passthrough.meaning: a door may pass through its own typed refusal with a code outside the gateway-owned set (for example guardrail or uncalibrated)
backend_passthrough.retryable: depends on the code — treat as refused, not transient

unimplemented.note: Classification discovery reports model_packing: false; execution is one native forward per input.
Review and fallback exist only as opt-in policy sub-documents inside POST /v1/classify.

unimplemented.surface: GET classification endpoints or compatibility aliases
unimplemented.note: The gateway serves classification only through POST /v1/classify; any future alias must run the same admission path before it is advertised.
Proposed and tracked under packaging work; oak and crates/jev are the callers today.

unimplemented.surface: hosted public endpoint and self-serve signup
unimplemented.note: No public base URL is published; keys are operator-issued.

unimplemented.surface: account mutations — top-up, payment, or credit over HTTP
unimplemented.note: POST, PUT, and DELETE on /v1/balance are refused; funding is an operator act on the ledger.

unimplemented.surface: free simulator or labeled test mode
unimplemented.note: A deterministic free simulator is a stated target; it does not exist.
Job-completion webhook delivery is implemented — a notify document on POST /v1/jobs with POST /v1/jobs/{id}/notify/rotate for secret rotation. Streaming response bodies do not exist anywhere.

unimplemented.surface: decision calls over the Nostr relay
unimplemented.note: A proposed transport contract, not a serving route.

unimplemented.surface: OAuth, image or multimodal input, paid-plan tiers
unimplemented.note: The service has no OAuth flow, accepts JSON-or-text state only, and publishes no pricing tiers.

discovery.auth: none — the discovery surface is public by design; every /v1 inference route still requires the bearer credential
discovery.content_negotiation: document routes answer their native representation by default and a rendered HTML page for Accept: text/html; canonical links travel as Link headers and <link rel=canonical>
discovery.origin: the operator's public_origin config, else the request's own Host over http

the API index — surfaces, schema versions, auth, contract links; JSON or HTML
what an agent needs to call the API
the OpenAPI 3.1 fragment for the implemented routes
the discovery document set's versioned index
the A2A-format agent card — interfaces, capabilities, skills, security
the agent-skills discovery index with sha256 digests of the served artifacts
the canonical skill artifact the index digests

related_surfaces.location: the oak-mcp-http binary's own listener at /mcp — this gateway does not run it; /mcp/server-card.json describes its contract and GET /mcp/card on that listener answers the same card live
